description: Free, no API key, at most 15 an hour per network. Test up to 12 likely keywords for an app (taken from its public listing, similar apps' titles and store autocomplete) with a live search each, and report where the app appears. A tested sample, never every keyword the app ranks for: neither store publishes that.

country.description: Two-letter storefront code (e.g. us, gb, de). Defaults to us.

platform.description: Store to read. Defaults to ios.

store_id.description: App Store numeric id or Google Play package name (from find_app).

name: competitor_keywords
